author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Runs cross-platform First Five placements using Twitch/Kick rewards and Viewer Foundation points on YouTube/TikTok, with one placement per viewer per stream.
changelog: 2.6.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.6.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.2: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.2 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.1: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.1 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.5.0: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.5.0 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.3: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.3 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.2: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.2 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.1: aligned with the stable THSV StreamBridge 2.4.1 baseline, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 2.4.0: added queue-skipping redemption safety, offline reward deactivation, controller-confirmed stream resets, clearer monthly leaderboard separation, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 1.0.0: initial release with one serialized five-place reward chain, stable Twitch user-ID enforcement, automatic per-stream reset, weighted monthly rankings, winner announcements, optional hosted leaderboard cards, and a separate two-action Streamer.bot companion package.

manifest.name: First Five
installationSteps: Import the separate First Five Streamer.bot package.
Keep its Controller action triggerless and approve only that action for this add-on.
Keep Twitch and Kick Reward Redemption attached to their existing platform intake actions.
Choose five Twitch IDs and five Kick IDs in placement order, then create the configured no-response command for YouTube and TikTok.
uninstallationSteps: Uninstall the add-on. Its compact leaderboard state remains preserved for a later reinstall.

healthChecks.description: Confirms serialized placement claims, reward transitions, and monthly leaderboard state.
